messages:
Maya R: Quick sync — partners shifted allocation for H100/H200 in EMEA and carrier dates for MI300. We need a decision on splitting SI GA from public marketplace announce.
Tom S: Curious — what's the magnitude of the shifts? Are they inventory-only or driver/firmware related?
NVIDIA - Alex: H200 EMEA batch delayed ~8 days due to logistic trunking. Not a firmware issue. We can still do a global announce if copy uses region availability callouts. Partners request 48h prebrief.
AMD - Clara: MI300 carrier shipments delayed 6 days; also a small firmware tweak for thermal tables landed today. We can push a patch overnight.
SI - Optima: Integrators asked for a 2-week validation window post-publish before enabling SI-managed accounts. That was a hard ask from several large customers.
Infra - Vega: Impact matrix: regenerating Gaudi kernels = ~24h, cross-region canaries = ~36h. Current canary snapshot:
```
base-image: redwood-ubuntu-24.04-gpu:v3
kernel: 6.1.80
cuda: 12.2
rocm: 5.9
model-optimizer: 3.2.1
```
Infra - Vega: If we stagger SI GA, we can publish to marketplace earlier and gate SI enrollments until we've distributed partner images and run SI-specific smoke tests.
Comms - Hana: Marketing prefers a single public announcement. But we're okay with a soft-window that calls out "regional availability" and an SI follow-up email 14 days after. That keeps press clean.
Maya R: Proposed path:
- Day 0: Partner prebrief + asset handoff (48h before public)
- Day 1: Infra kernel regen + start NA/EMEA canaries (limited traffic)
- Day 3: Partner + legal signoff on soft copy (firm-dates variant ready as fallback)
- Day 4: Marketplace publish (if canary green)
- Day 18: SI GA (enable enterprise onboarding after extra validation)
NVIDIA - Alex: Ok on prebrief. Please mark performance numbers as "preliminary".
AMD - Clara: We'll push firmware patch tonight; if any regression remains we notify immediately.
Infra - Vega: Spun up 4-node canary (2 NA, 1 EMEA, 1 APAC). Telemetry prefix: s3://redwood/partner-canaries/1732101111/.
release-bot: Canary started: canary-1732101111 -> https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/1732101111/logs
Tom S: Also note: B200 power profile change impacted one regression test in our latency suite yesterday. If vendors change thermal tables again we need an extra perf run.
Infra - Vega: Noted. We'll include latency suite in the canary.
Comms - Hana: I'll draft two asset sets: soft-window (no firm ship dates) and firm-date (for partners who confirm inventory). ETA EOD.
Maya R: Legal reminder: partner quote approvals required; Legal needs ~24h for review. Tag Legal on the asset PR.
NVIDIA - Alex: Can we include a short embargo note: "Partners will be prebriefed 48h before public"?
Maya R: Yes, we'll include that in comms.
release-bot: Canary completed: status=PASS, metrics -> s3://redwood/partner-canaries/1732101111/artifacts.tgz
Infra - Vega: Canary PASS. Kernel paths OK. Gaudi regen added ~22h total. B200 thermal delta +2.1% peak but within SLO; flagging in release notes.
SI - Optima: Good. We'll hold SI enrollments until Day 18 and coordinate image distribution to integrators on Day 6. That gives us time to remediate any SI-specific issues.
Comms - Hana: Drafts uploaded: https://docs.redwood/announcements/drafts/1732101111 (soft + firm). Tagging Legal in the doc.
Maya R: Action items: Vega upload full canary metrics; Hana circulate soft-window first; Tom coordinate SI validation checklist with Optima; Legal on partner loop. Partner call scheduled 10am PT tomorrow to confirm windows.
NVIDIA - Alex: Will join call.
AMD - Clara: Will be oncall.
Maya R: If partners sign-off, proceed with marketplace publish Day 4 gated on canary green; SI GA Day 18. If anything red, hold and use soft-window messaging. :white_check_mark:
